### :material-code-braces: Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template — `DATA_ROOT` via `--data-root`, the rest via `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | mhcquant output directory (the per-sample <sample>.tsv tables, intermediate_results/, multiqc/, pipeline_info/). |
| `METADATA_FILE` | — | The samplesheet the run was started with (--input: ID, Sample, Condition, ReplicateFileName, optional Fasta and SearchPreset). Defaults to input/samplesheet.tsv under DATA_ROOT. |
| `METADATA_ID_COL` | — | Samplesheet id column. mhcquant fixes it to ID (one per raw file); the template joins on the derived sample_id and run_id keys instead, so this only records the auto-detected value. |
| `GROUP_COL` | — | Samplesheet column the dashboard groups and filters samples by. Defaults to Condition, the column the mhcquant input schema requires. |
| `GROUP_COL_DISPLAY` | — | Reader-facing label of GROUP_COL, used in filter and card titles. |
| `NO_QUANTIFICATION` | — | Set (--var NO_QUANTIFICATION=true) for a run without --quantify: the peptide tables carry no replicate intensities, so the replicate collections and the Reproducibility tab are removed. |
| `NO_ION_ANNOTATION` | — | Set (--var NO_ION_ANNOTATION=true) for a run without --annotate_ions: intermediate_results/ion_annotations/ is absent, so the fragment-ion collection is removed. |

**Origin** tells you whether a collection is *real pipeline data* or a reshape of it: <span class="gtd-badge gtd-direct">direct</span> = a pipeline output (scanned, or a recipe that reads raw files); <span class="gtd-badge gtd-derived">derived</span> = a recipe that reshapes one or more *direct* collections into the layout a visualization needs (no new measurement). **Reads** shows what produces it: a <span class="gtd-badge gtd-recipe">recipe</span> `.py` transform, whose name links to its source on GitHub, or a raw <span class="gtd-badge gtd-file">file</span> scanned off disk. ### :material-directions-fork: Conditional routes

Rows are data collections; columns are the variables you set or `params.json` flags auto-detected from the run. Each filled cell is the effect of **setting** that variable; an **empty cell** means that variable leaves the collection unchanged. (11 collections are unaffected by any variable — present on every run.)

### :material-chef-hat: Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `EXPECTED_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`mhcquant/fragment_ions.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mhcquant/fragment_ions.py) | Fragment-ion annotation summary, one row per sample and peptidoform. | `sample`, `peptide`, `fragment_ions`, `b_ions`, `y_ions`, `other_ions`, `fragment_error_ppm`, `matched_intensity` |
| [`mhcquant/length_distribution.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mhcquant/length_distribution.py) | Peptide length distribution per sample, the class I / class II signature. | `sample`, `length`, `length_class`, `length_window`, `peptides`, `fraction` |
| [`mhcquant/motif_matrix.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mhcquant/motif_matrix.py) | Amino-acid frequency per peptide position, per sample and length. | `row_id`, `sample`, `length_class`, `position`, `peptides`, `A`, `C`, `D`, `E`, `F`, `G`, `H`, `I`, `K`, `L`, `M`, `N`, `P`, `Q`, `R`, `S`, `T`, `V`, `W`, `Y` |
| [`mhcquant/peptide_composition.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mhcquant/peptide_composition.py) | Per-sample composition of the identified peptides, three ways. | `sample`, `rank`, `category`, `peptides` |
| [`mhcquant/peptides.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mhcquant/peptides.py) | Identified peptides, one row per sample and precursor (peptidoform and charge). | `sample`, `peptide`, `sequence`, `length`, `length_class`, `length_window`, `modification_state`, `score`, `score_type`, `psms`, `rt_min`, `predicted_rt_min`, `rt_error_min`, `mz`, `charge`, `charge_state`, `neutral_mass`, `gravy`, `anchor_p2`, `anchor_c_term`, `protein`, `protein_entry`, `proteins`, `n_proteins`, `aa_before`, `aa_after`, `start`, `spectrum_correlation`, `log10_intensity`, `replicates_quantified`, `replicates_total`, `fragment_ions`, `fragment_error_ppm` |
| [`mhcquant/replicate_detection.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mhcquant/replicate_detection.py) | Replicate membership matrix, one row per sample and peptidoform. | `sample`, `peptide`, `replicates_detected` |
| [`mhcquant/replicate_intensity.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mhcquant/replicate_intensity.py) | Peptide intensity per raw replicate, long format. | `sample`, `peptide`, `sequence`, `replicate`, `replicate_label`, `detected`, `log10_intensity` |
| [`mhcquant/replicate_pairs.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mhcquant/replicate_pairs.py) | Replicate-against-replicate peptide intensities, one row per peptide and pair. | `sample`, `peptide`, `pair`, `intensity_a`, `intensity_b` |
| [`mhcquant/sample_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mhcquant/sample_summary.py) | Identification yield and immunopeptidome signature, one row per sample. | `sample`, `psms`, `peptides`, `peptidoforms`, `proteins`, `modified_fraction`, `median_length`, `ninemer_fraction`, `class_i_fraction`, `class_ii_fraction`, `median_score`, `median_abs_rt_error_min`, `replicates`, `all_replicates_fraction`, `replicate_median_r`, `replicate_min_r` |
| [`mhcquant/source_proteins.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mhcquant/source_proteins.py) | Source proteins of the presented peptides, one row per sample and protein. | `sample`, `protein`, `protein_entry`, `peptides`, `shared_peptides`, `psms`, `best_score`, `log10_intensity`, `peptide_list` |
| [`nf-core/mhcquant/condition_sharing.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/mhcquant/recipes/condition_sharing.py) | Peptides shared between conditions, one row per peptide sequence. | `sequence`, `length`, `length_class`, `samples_detected`, `conditions_detected`, `sharing`, `conditions` |
| [`nf-core/mhcquant/samples.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/mhcquant/recipes/samples.py) | Sample hub for nf-core/mhcquant: the run's samplesheet, one row per MS raw file. | `sample_id`, `run_id`, `replicate`, `raw_file`, `Sample`, `Condition` |
| [`openms/comet_fdr_curve.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/openms/comet_fdr_curve.py) | Identifications against FDR threshold per raw file, from the Comet search. | `run_id`, `q_value`, `accepted_psms`, `xcorr_threshold` |
| [`openms/comet_psms.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/openms/comet_psms.py) | Comet database search yield per raw file, before rescoring. | `run_id`, `spectra_searched`, `target_psms`, `decoy_psms`, `psms_1pct_fdr`, `psms_5pct_fdr`, `identification_rate`, `median_xcorr_target`, `median_xcorr_decoy`, `median_mass_error_ppm`, `median_peptide_length` |
